newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures finish lackluster day lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures finish lackluster day lower.

text.p: June 9 - U.S. debt futures ended an overall lackluster day lower, hampered by profit-taking after Friday's big move. Friday was second-highest volume day ever and open interest rose more than 27,000. Trade quiet Monday. One major U.S. dealer reportedly sold 10,000 to 13,000 Sept bonds. "I think it was just a correction today," a broker said.
